preregistration.requiredBefore: first original headroom002 operation dispatch claim and any workload raw creation
rules: binding must refer to the actual new prepared plan and frozen execution spec, not the local non-runnable draft
freeze binding and include its hash in the existing pre-dispatch launch evidence before original operation invocation
offline report must independently verify the original launch binding and that raw belongs to the bound plan/spec/source
pending/missing/late binding cannot produce engineering passed; this criteria file alone is not a measurement binding
do not edit original002 plan or execution spec to insert this separate assessment

driverPressure.elu: recorded source-bound phase utilization must be finite in [0,1]; raw has no active/idle counters, so independent ELU derivation is unavailable
driverPressure.cpuQuotaNormalized: diagnostic only; never clears original absolute 0.8-core gate
driverPressure.scope: whole Node phase including drain; not per-window or whole-driver cgroup CPU

p99EngineeringConsistency.observations: correct measurement observations of each whole 120-second run; never pool arms/windows/blocks
p99EngineeringConsistency.interpretation: predeclared engineering consistency under CPU allocation and two repeated observations; no statistical equivalence, confidence interval or true capacity claim
p99EngineeringConsistency.numberBasis: prospective engineering tolerance using the existing 1ms/10% descriptive drift budget; the symmetric minimum avoids favoring order or CPU allocation

warmupTransition.windowOwnership: existing arrival cohorts; sentMs or unsent observedMs; each phase has its own zero
warmupTransition.summary: reference=median(last two warmup window quantiles), candidate=median(first two measurement window quantiles), independently for each metric and cell
warmupTransition.crossWindowHandling: retain completed arrival-cohort records and crossing flags; missing terminal/timing/count evidence is unknown; arrival cohorts are not completion-rate windows
warmupTransition.passedMeaning: warmup-transition-consistent within this fixed observation; not whole-measurement steady state

include: P50/P95 with sample status, P99 unknown at insufficient counts

decision.scopeEngineeringPassedWhen: prospective binding and evidence verified; all36 cells complete and HTTP/pressure/P99-consistency/warmup-transition gates passed; no private verdict substitutes
decision.observedThresholdViolation: failed with explicit metric/value/budget; retain all unknown/missing items too
decision.missingOrInsufficientEvidence: unknown; engineering acceptance false; known failures remain separately reported
decision.corruptOrUnboundEvidence: evidence invalid; engineering acceptance false; do not evaluate untrusted values as passed
decision.empiricalFalsePositiveCertification: optional and independent; not a prerequisite for this engineering assessment
